election.name: 2022 General Election — Presidential
election.portal_role: Official public result-form portal containing constituency Form 34B scans uploaded from the constituency result path.

measure.name: Presidential voter turnout
measure.rounding: Retain source integers; round display percentage only after calculation.

authority_notes: Form 34B is the regulated constituency collation form and records polling-station registered voters, total valid votes and rejected ballots.
The IEBC result path requires the Constituency Returning Officer to collate Form 34A results into Form 34B and upload the scanned Form 34B to the public portal.
Citizen or media transcriptions may be used only as non-canonical QA aids; canonical promotion requires official IEBC evidence.

reconciliation.registered_voter_authority: IEBC Gazette Notice No. 7290 / existing P23 constituency registered-voter series
reconciliation.rule: The Form 34B constituency registered-voter total must reconcile to the canonical 2022 IEBC constituency voter denominator before turnout is promoted. Any mismatch remains unresolved and is investigated; it is never force-adjusted.
reconciliation.valid_vote_rule: When candidate columns are extractable, their sum must equal Form 34B total valid votes.

extraction.required_artifact: A deterministic 290-row extraction manifest with constituency code/name, official Form 34B source reference, registered voters, total valid votes, rejected ballots, turnout percentage and extraction verification state.
extraction.ocr_policy: OCR may assist discovery/transcription but no OCR-only value is promoted without source-level validation against the official Form 34B.

acceptance: Exactly 290 current constituency geographies are covered or explicitly unresolved; no silent omissions.
Every promoted row points to official IEBC Form 34B evidence from the 2022 presidential election.
All denominator values reconcile to the governed constituency registered-voter series.
All promoted turnout values satisfy numerator/denominator and range checks.
No county, ward, media or citizen-tally value is inherited or substituted for missing official constituency evidence.
The existing 20,115-slot completeness denominator does not change.
After materialization and rebuild, the 290 turnout-only P23 slot instances move to complete and P23 reaches its acceptance gate.
